Here are the environmental conditions for Robinia pseudoacacia (Black Locust) seed germination and growth:

• Temperature: 20-25°C
• Hydrometry: 50-60%
• Sunshine: 8-10 hrs
• Rainfall: 600-800 mm
• Humidity: 60-70%
• Soil pH: 6.0-7.5
• Soil type: Sandy loam
• Soil drainage: Well-drained
• Elevation: 0-1500 m
• Wind tolerance: High
• Frost resistance: -30°C
• Germination rate: 70-85%
• Seed viability: 3-5 years
• Planting depth: 1-2 cm
